name: Cross-GeGLU (Triton)
tagline: Splits the 4d hidden in halves and cross-gates each half by a GELU of the other, all fused in Triton with custom backward and activation recompute.
formula: $$ h = xW_{fc}^\top,\; (h_1, h_2) = \mathrm{split}_2(h) $$ $$ a_1 = \mathrm{GELU}(h_1)\odot h_2,\quad a_2 = \mathrm{GELU}(h_2)\odot h_1 $$ $$ \mathrm{MLP}(x) = [a_1, a_2]\,W_{proj}^\top $$

key_hyperparams.name: GELU approx
key_hyperparams.role: numerical-stability of GELU inside the kernel

key_hyperparams.name: save tensor
key_hyperparams.role: memory savings via activation recompute in backward

init_recovers: GeGLU when one half is treated as pure gate
diff_from_baseline: Versus the triton_gelu baseline this changes the activation from per-element GELU on the full 4d expansion to a symmetric GeGLU variant that cross-gates the two halves so each contributes both as value and gate. Backward keeps only h via Triton-recomputed activation.

name: Half-sigmoid GLU concat (PyTorch)
tagline: Splits w_fc across rows; outputs concat([h1, h1*sigmoid(h2)]) so the projection sees both raw and sigmoid-gated halves, no Triton.
formula: $$ h_1 = x W_{fc,1}^\top,\; h_2 = x W_{fc,2}^\top,\; g = \sigma(h_2) $$ $$ \mathrm{MLP}(x) = [\,h_1\,;\, h_1 \odot g\,]\, W_{proj}^\top $$
diff_from_baseline: A pure-PyTorch custom autograd op: replaces the GELU activation with a concatenation [h1, h1·sigmoid(h2)], i.e. a sigmoid-gated GLU but keeping the raw value branch alongside the gated one. No fusion or Triton kernels.

name: Symmetric SwiGLU (interleaved Triton)
tagline: Pairs adjacent hidden channels and computes act_1 = h1*SiLU(h2), act_2 = h2*SiLU(h1) in a fused interleaved Triton kernel.
formula: $$ \text{for each pair } (h_1, h_2) \text{ in } h = xW_{fc}^\top:\quad a_1 = h_1 \cdot \mathrm{SiLU}(h_2),\; a_2 = h_2 \cdot \mathrm{SiLU}(h_1) $$ $$ \mathrm{MLP}(x) = a\, W_{proj}^\top $$
init_recovers: GLU/SwiGLU when one entry of each pair is treated as pure gate
diff_from_baseline: Versus triton_gelu/triton_relu_sq, replaces GELU/ReLU^2 with a Symmetric SwiGLU on adjacent channel pairs; the activation is fully fused in Triton, with a matching analytic SiLU-grad kernel for backward.

name: ReLU^2 * GELU GLU (folded proj)
tagline: Splits the 4d hidden into two 2d branches, multiplies value=ReLU(a)^2/sqrt(2) by gate=GELU(b), and folds the two halves of w_proj into one summed projection.

key_hyperparams.name: w_proj fold
key_hyperparams.role: force tied projection across the gated branches

init_recovers: Standard ReLU^2 MLP if g≡1 (no GELU gate)
diff_from_baseline: Versus the relu_sq_torch baseline this introduces a multiplicative GELU gate over the second half and rescales the value branch by 1/sqrt(2); it also halves the projection's effective output by summing w_proj's two halves, making both branches share the same readout direction.

name: Triton SiLU MLP
tagline: Replaces GELU with element-wise SiLU implemented as a forward+backward Triton kernel; no GLU split, full 4d width preserved.
diff_from_baseline: Versus triton_gelu, this swaps the GELU activation for SiLU in the same fused-elementwise Triton template, retaining the 4d hidden expansion and dense linear-act-linear structure (no GLU branching).
